store_listing.value: Tune viola, bass & orchestra · Drone · Tempo · Intonation trainer

privacy.value: The listing says microphone audio is analysed live and never recorded; no account, analytics or servers are used. Google Play declares no data collected or shared.

limitations.value: A phone tuner is a practice aid. Room noise, microphone quality and playing technique can affect detection.

features.name: Tuning profiles for 60 instruments, including bowed, plucked, wind and world instruments
Reference pitch from 392 to 466 Hz and presets for 415, 442 and 443 Hz
Drone, tanpura, shruti box, metronome, tuning fork and pitch pipe
Intonation trainer with scale practice and sharp-or-flat heatmap
Stand mode and teacher mode with QR setup sharing
Live on-device microphone analysis without recording
